text:
alix: Spotted during UX pass: dark-mode gradients on the metrics card make small sparkline lines invisible. Also syntax theme highlights for types feel too low contrast on the console. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ux/graphite-ink-sample.png

marco: Agree. The sparkline uses #2b3a44 on a #0c0f12 card; it blends. Suggest swapping to a lighter accent for lines (#78cfff) or adding a 1px glow to improve visibility at 1px.

jade: For syntax, types are currently pale lavender (#bfbce6) — contrast 3.2:1. We should aim for >=4.5:1. I propose deepening to #9b8fe0 or using semi-bold for type tokens.

ops-bot: Deployed color audit report 1962104300: found 8 instances failing AA contrast on dark theme, including chart lines and code tokens. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/reports/color-audit/1962104300

marco: Minimal CSS tweak to try:
```css
:root {
  --card-bg: #0b0f12;
  --sparkline: #78cfff; /* brighter */
  --type-token: #9b8fe0; /* deeper */
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px rgba(120,207,255,0.12);
}
```
We should run the color-audit after this.

alix: Also copy nit: legend labels currently say "Rate" which is ambiguous. Change to "Requests / min" or the metric unit. Small but avoids confusion.

jade: Can we add a pref to toggle "high visibility" mode? It would increase contrast and add thicker lines for users who opt-in. Store in profile settings.

design-bot: Accessibility checks queued: proposed type-token (#9b8fe0) vs code-bg => 4.6:1 PASS; sparkline #78cfff vs card-bg => 5.2:1 PASS. Added items: "add high-visibility toggle" and "update legend unit labels".

marco: I'll push a tiny PR with the CSS vars + chart stroke heuristic (min 2px when not aggregated). Jade can review token weight change.

alix: Thanks — let's validate in dark-mode QA before next beta. :thumbsup:
